theorem ownRaftGhost_step_recordVote [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (m : Msg) (s : PState) (Hty : m.ty = MsgType.voteResp) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hterm : m.term =
    s.term) (Hrole : s.role = Role.candidate) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [m], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ
    (rdCount [m]) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term :=
    s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes m.src
    !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched :=
    s.matched, rd := s.rd } md

theorem ownRaftGhost_rd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' :
    PState) (ms : List Msg) (Hs' : s' = { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role :=
    s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox ++ ms, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit :=
    s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s'.rd }) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, isMessage γ m) -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ (∀ kl, ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ rdOwn γ id s ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗ rdOwn γ id s') ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s' md

theorem isMessage_readIndex_tr [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m m' : Msg) : m.ty =
    MsgType.readIndex → m'.ty = MsgType.readIndex → m'.entries = m.entries → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗
    isMessage γ m'

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_commit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM)
    (id : w64) (s : PState) (n : w64) : s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z n → uint.Z n
    ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log → plogTermAt s.base s.log n = some s.term → JQuorum c (ackedBy s
    n) → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ regsOwn γ -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
    s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := n, matched := s.matched, rd
    := s.rd } md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_send_apps [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM)
    (id : w64) (s : PState) (ms : List Msg) : s.role = Role.leader → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → ReplOk
    id s m) → (γ.reDyn ≠ none → ∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → AppCommitEq s m) → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → m.ty
    = MsgType.snap → ∀ (T : GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → id ∈ T ∧ m.dst ∈ T) → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c
    s -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs s ms) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_stepC_in [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (HC :
    CfgStatic γ c) (id : w64) (HT : TrackedOk γ c id) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (s : PState) (recv
    : List Msg) (s' : PState) : StepC c id B s recv s' → ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ regsOwn γ
    -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ recv, isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s' md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_app_stale [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.src ≠ id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠
    Role.leader → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (psendMsgs (padoptLeader s m.src) [Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id m.src s.term false s.commit (W64 0)
    (W64 0) (W64 0) []]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_respond [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (t :
    PState) (q : ReadReq) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id t md -∗ respFacts γ q ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id (preadRespond id t q) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_lose [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (id
    : w64) (s : PState) (Hrole : s.role = Role.candidate) (Hnq : JLost c s.votes) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈
    [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount []) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id (pbecomeFollower s s.term (W64 0)) md

theorem regs_open [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (P Q : IProp GF) : ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗
    £ 1 -∗ (regsOwn γ -∗ P ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗ Q) -∗ P ={⊤}=∗ Q

theorem preceipt_zero_bound [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (n : Nat) : ⊢ |==> ⧖(Int.toNat 0 - n)

theorem ownRaftGhost_ackIn_le [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) (i : w64) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ackIn γ s.term i -∗
    ⌜uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_app_reject [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (hint hintterm : w64) : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.src ≠ id → s.role ≠
    Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z m.index → ¬PlogMatches s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm,
    index' := m.index } → RejHintOk s.base s.log m.index m.logterm hint → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (padoptLeader s m.src) [Msg.mk
    MsgType.appResp id m.src s.term true m.index hintterm (W64 0) hint []]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_takeReads [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} {E : CoPset} (γ :
    RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount [])
    -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={E}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead :=
    s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log,
    commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                have __src := s.rd;
                { ro := __src.ro, pend := __src.pend } }
            md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_single [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c :
    CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.readIndex → s.role = Role.leader →
    plogTermAt s.base s.log s.commit = some s.term → CfgSingle c id → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ isMessage
    γ m -∗ rdCred γ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (preadRespondAll id s [{ index := s.commit, src := m.src, ents := m.entries }]) md

theorem ownLogGhost_ack_le [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (t i : w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ v s kl -∗ ackEv γ v t i -∗ ⌜uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z s.term⌝

theorem rdCount_replOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (ms : List Msg) (h : ∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → ReplOk id
    s m) : rdCount ms = 0

def lastRec [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜L = 0⌝ ∨ ∃ e, isEntry γ e ∗ ⌜uint.Z e.Index' = L⌝)

theorem ownRaftGhost_respondAll [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (qs
    : List ReadReq) (t : PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id t md -∗ ([∗list] q ∈ qs, respFacts γ q) ={⊤ \
    ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (preadRespondAll id t qs) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_abandon [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (Hrole : s.role ≠ Role.leader) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ
    (rdCount []) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (pbecomeFollower
    s s.term (W64 0)) md

    (m : Msg) (s : PState) (Hty : m.ty = MsgType.vote) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hfrom : m.src ≠ W64 0)
    (Hterm : m.term = s.term) (Hcan : PCanVote s m.src) (Hutd : plogUpToDate s.base s.log { term' :=
    m.logterm, index' := m.index } = true) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [m], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount

    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } [Msg.plain
    MsgType.voteResp id m.src s.term false]) md

theorem commitIn_ackIn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ldr t : w64) (bL : entryID) (l fp
    F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) : uint.Z tm ≤ uint.Z t → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ leadPrefix γ ldr t bL l
    -∗ lpfull γ ldr t bL l fp -∗ commitIn γ F c tm -∗ votesTbl γ ∗ ackIn γ t c

theorem term_log_insert_stamped [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γt : GName) (M : GMap w64 (EntryM × w64))
    (T : w64) (L : Int) (ents : List EntryM) (ptf : Nat → w64) : 0 ≤ L → L + ↑ents.length < 2 ^ 64 →
    (∀ (i : w64), (M !! i).isSome = true → uint.Z i ≤ L) → ⊢ ghostMapAuth γt 1 M -∗ ([∗map] i ↦ e ∈
    M, i ↪[γt]□ e) ==∗ ∃ M', ghostMapAuth γt 1 M' ∗ ([∗map] i ↦ e ∈ M', i ↪[γt]□ e) ∗ ⌜∀ (i : w64),
    (M' !! i).isSome = true → uint.Z i ≤ L + ↑ents.length⌝ ∗ [∗list] k ↦ e ∈ List.mapIdx (stamp T
    (W64 L)) ents, e.Index' ↪[γt]□ (e, ptf k)

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_sendFree [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) (Hfree : m.ty = MsgType.preVote ∨ m.ty = MsgType.preVoteResp) (Hfrom :
    m.src = id) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount []) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s
    md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs s [m]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_drain [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) (o' out : List Msg) (Hp : (o' ++ out).Perm s.outbox) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
    s.votes, outbox := o', base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched,
    rd := s.rd } md ∗ rdCred γ (rdCount s.outbox - rdCount o') ∗ msgsTks γ out

theorem ownRaftGhost_lastRec [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ lastRec γ (plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log) ∗ ⌜plogLastIndexZ
    s.base s.log < 2 ^ 64⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_reject_ok [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl
    : Option w64) (m : Msg) (hint : w64) (Hty : m.ty = MsgType.app) (Hle : uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z
    m.index) (Hnm : ¬PlogMatches s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index }) (Hh :
    RejHintOk s.base s.log m.index m.logterm hint) : ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗
    ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → ↑γ.reBoot.length < uint.Z m.index ∧ 1 ≤ uint.Z hint ∧ uint.Z hint ≤ uint.Z
    m.index⌝ ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl

theorem lastRec_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : Int) : Persistent (lastRec γ L)

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_arrive [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.readIndex → s.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt
    s.base s.log s.commit = some s.term → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ rdCred γ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md
    ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role
    := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit :=
    s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                      have __src := s.rd;
                      { states := __src.states,
                        ro := readonlyArrive s.rd.ro id { index := s.commit, src := m.src, ents := m.entries },
                        pend := __src.pend } }
                  md

theorem isMessage_app_inv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.app →
    ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ⌜AppPayloadOk m⌝ ∗ isLeader γ m.src m.term ∗ (∃ bL l fp, leadPrefix γ m.src
    m.term bL l ∗ ⌜plogTermAt bL l m.index = some m.logterm ∧ m.entries <+: plogFrom bL l (m.index +
    W64 1)⌝ ∗ lpfull γ m.src m.term bL l fp ∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ l) m.commit m.term ∗ isCommitted γ
    (List.take (uint.Z m.commit).toNat (fp ++ l)) ∗ dynOn γ iprop(⌜ConfI1 (fp ++ l) (uint.Z
    m.commit).toNat⌝)) ∗ ⌜m.src ≠ W64 0⌝

theorem ownRaftGhost_single_confirm [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM)
    (id : w64) (s : PState) (cx : List w8) (Lc : List EntryM) : s.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt
    s.base s.log s.commit = some s.term → CfgSingle c id → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s
    md -∗ readReq γ cx Lc ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ∗ readOk γ cx s.commit

theorem tks_drop [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {k : Nat} {R A B T C D : IProp GF} {E : CoPset} (h : ⊢ ⧖k
    -∗ R -∗ A -∗ B -∗ C ={E}=∗ D) : ⊢ ⧖k -∗ R -∗ A -∗ B -∗ T -∗ C ={E}=∗ D

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_release_single [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames)
    (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : PState) : s.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt s.base s.log s.commit =
    some s.term → CfgSingle c id → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN
    γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (preadRespondAll id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead,
    role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit :=
    s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                      have __src := s.rd;
                      { states := __src.states, ro := __src.ro } }
                  (List.map (fun p => { index := s.commit, src := p.fst.From', ents := p.snd }) s.rd.pend))
                md

theorem ownRaftGhost_stepC [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (HC :
    CfgStatic γ c) (id : w64) (HT : TrackedOk γ c id) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (s : PState) (recv
    : List Msg) (s' : PState) : StepC c id B s recv s' → ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ ([∗list]
    m ∈ recv, isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ
    id s md ={⊤}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s' md

theorem ownLogGhost_hbResp [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (L : w64) (ctx : List w8) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ v s kl -∗ (⌜ctx = []⌝ ∨ ∃ q recs, ⌜ctx =
    u64Le q ∧ uint.nat q ≤ recs.length⌝ ∗ rqLb γ L s.term recs ∗ [∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ s.term
    r) -∗ ⌜ctx = []⌝ ∨ ∃ q recs, ⌜ctx = u64Le q ∧ HbAckOk v (uint.nat q) recs⌝ ∗ rqLb γ L s.term
    recs

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_rematch [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (mt : GMap w64 w64) : s.role = Role.leader → (∀ (v i : w64), mt !! v = some i →
    uint.Z i = 0 ∨ s.matched !! v = some i) → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term
    := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := mt, rd := s.rd } md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_win [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (mt : GMap w64 w64) (ms : List Msg) (n : Nat) : s.role = Role.candidate →
    JQuorum c (granted s.votes) → plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → LeaderMatchOk id s mt →
    (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → ReplOk id (pwinState id s mt) m) → (γ.reDyn ≠ none → ∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms
    → AppCommitEq (pwinState id s mt) m) → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → m.ty = MsgType.snap → ∀ (T : GSet
    w64), γ.reTracked = some T → id ∈ T ∧ m.dst ∈ T) → plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log + 1 ≤ ↑n +
    ↑γ.reBoot.length → ⊢ ⧖n -∗ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (pwinState id s mt) ([pselfAck id (pwinState id s mt)] ++ ms)) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_rdR [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' :
    PState) (ms : List Msg) (R : IProp GF) (Hs' : s' = { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead :=
    s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox ++ ms, base := s.base, log :=
    s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s'.rd }) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ ms, isMessage γ
    m) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ (∀ kl, ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ rdOwn γ id s ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN
    γ)}=∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗ rdOwn γ id s' ∗ R) ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s' md
    ∗ R

theorem recv_one [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [m], isMessage
    γ m) -∗ isMessage γ m

theorem confirm_all [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (Q : GSet w64) (X : IProp
    GF) (Hconf : ∀ (r : RqRec), (∀ (v : w64), v ∈ Q → ∀ (t' : w64) (qq : GSet w64), r.snd = some
    (t', qq) → ¬v ∈ qq) → ⊢ X -∗ rqRecOk γ T r -∗ readOk γ r.fst.fst r.fst.snd) (rs : List RqRec) :
    ⊢ X -∗ ([∗list] r ∈ rs, rqRecOk γ T r) -∗ [∗list] r ∈ rs, iprop(∀ x, readOk γ r.fst.fst
    r.fst.snd)

    s m) : propsOf ms = []

theorem ownRaftGhost_arrive [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (t :
    PState) (src : w64) (ents : List EntryM) (t' : PState) : t.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt
    t.base t.log t.commit = some t.term → t' = { term := t.term, vote := t.vote, lead := t.lead,
    role := t.role, votes := t.votes, outbox := t.outbox, base := t.base, log := t.log, commit :=
    t.commit, matched := t.matched, rd :=
              have __src := t.rd;
              { states := __src.states, ro := readonlyArrive t.rd.ro id { index := t.commit, src := src, ents := ents },
                pend := __src.pend } } →
        ⊢
          ownRaftGhost γ id t md -∗
            (∃ e c Lc, ⌜ents = [e]⌝ ∗ ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ ∗ readReq γ c Lc) -∗
              rdCred γ 1 ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id t' md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_state [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (e : EntryM) : m.ty = MsgType.readIndexResp → m.entries = [e] → ⊢
    isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term :=
    s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                  have __src := s.rd;
                  { states := s.rd.states ++ [{ Index' := m.index, RequestCtx' := e.Data' }], ro := __src.ro,
                    pend := __src.pend } }
              md

theorem ownRaftGhost_term1 [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → ∀ (t0 : w64), plogTermAt s.base s.log
    (W64 1) = some t0 → uint.Z t0 ≤ 1⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_app_resp [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) (x : w64) : m.ty = MsgType.appResp → m.term = s.term → s.role =
    Role.leader → m.reject = false → s.matched !! m.src = some x → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ
    id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role,
    votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched
    := <[m.src := if uint.Z x < uint.Z m.index then m.index else x]>s.matched, rd := s.rd } md

theorem isMessage_snap_prefix [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty =
    MsgType.snap) : ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } fp⌝ ∗
    logRecs γ base0 fp

theorem ownRaftGhost_inv_md [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ raftCommitInv γ

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_prop_forward [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty = MsgType.propose) : ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ msgTks γ m -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs s [Msg.mkV MsgType.propose id s.lead
    (W64 0) m.reject m.index m.logterm m.commit m.rejecthint m.entries [] m.ctx]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_ack [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM)
    (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (N : w64) : m.ty = MsgType.heartbeatResp → m.dst = id → m.term
    = s.term → s.role = Role.leader → m.ctx ≠ [] → JQuorumAcked c (fun v => ((readonlyRecvAck
    s.rd.ro m.src m.ctx).acks !! v).getD (W64 0)) N → ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ isMessage γ m -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (preadRespondAll id { term :=
    s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                              have __src := s.rd;
                              { states := __src.states,
                                ro := (readonlyAdvance (readonlyRecvAck s.rd.ro m.src m.ctx) N).fst,
                                pend := __src.pend } }
                          (readonlyAdvance (readonlyRecvAck s.rd.ro m.src m.ctx) N).snd)
                        md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_campaign [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (c : CfgM)
    (id : w64) (s : PState) (peers : List w64) (cl : List w8) (Hrole : s.role ≠ Role.leader) (Hin :
    id ∈ c.voters) (Hnw : uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64) (Hperm : peers.Perm (elements (c.voters \
    {id}))) : ⊢ dynEnv γ id c s -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount []) -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (pbecomeCandidate id
    s) ([Msg.plain MsgType.voteResp id id (pbecomeCandidate id s).term false] ++ List.map (fun dst
    => pvoteReq id dst (pbecomeCandidate id s).term (plogLast s.base s.log) cl) peers)) md ∗ ∃ fp,
    ⌜FullOk s.base fp⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp ∗ isCampK γ id (s.term + W64 1) (fp ++ s.log) s.commit

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_beat [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) (ms : List Msg) : s.role = Role.leader → (∀ (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → HeartbeatOk id s m) → (∀
    (m : Msg), m ∈ ms → HbCtxOk s.rd.ro m.ctx) → ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (psendMsgs s ms) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_app_accept [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (lastnewi : w64) (es' : List EntryM) : m.ty = MsgType.app → m.src ≠
    id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠ Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z m.index → plogMaybeAppend
    s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index } m.entries = some (lastnewi, es') → ⊢
    isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (have __src :=
    padoptLeader s m.src; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role :=
    __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := es', commit
    :=
                            plogCommitTo s.commit (if uint.Z m.commit < uint.Z lastnewi then m.commit else lastnewi),
                          matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd })
                        [Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id m.src s.term false lastnewi (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []])
                      md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_drain [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s
    : PState) (o' : List Msg) (Hsub : o'.Subperm s.outbox) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗
    rdCred γ (rdCount []) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term
    := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := o', base
    := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } md

theorem regs_frame [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {A B C D : IProp GF} (γ : RaftNames) (h : ⊢ A -∗ B -∗ C
    ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ D) : ⊢ regsOwn γ -∗ A -∗ B -∗ C ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗ D

theorem ownLogGhost_leader_last [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState)
    (kl : Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜s.role = Role.leader → γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤
    plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝ ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_higherTerm [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (m : Msg) (s : PState) (Hlt : uint.Z s.term < uint.Z m.term) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hfl :
    fromLeader m.ty = true → m.src ≠ id) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [m], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount
    [m]) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (pbecomeFollower s
    m.term (if fromLeader m.ty = true then m.src else W64 0)) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_leader_last [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s
    : PState) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜s.role = Role.leader → γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 2 ≤
    plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_snap_fastfwd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.snap → m.src ≠ id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠
    Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z m.index → PlogMatches s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm,
    index' := m.index } → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs
    (have __src := padoptLeader s m.src; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead :=
    __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, base :=
    __src.base, log := __src.log, commit := m.index, matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd })
    [Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id m.src s.term false m.index (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_fwd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.readIndex → s.role ≠ Role.leader → s.lead ≠ W64 0 → ⊢
    isMessage γ m -∗ rdCred γ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (psendMsgs s [{ ty := m.ty, src := if m.src = W64 0 then id else m.src, dst := s.lead, term :=
    W64 0, reject := m.reject, index := m.index, logterm := m.logterm, commit := m.commit,
    rejecthint := m.rejecthint, entries := m.entries, cl := m.cl, al := m.al, ctx := m.ctx }]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_snap_restore [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.snap → m.src ≠ id → m.term = s.term → s.role ≠
    Role.leader → uint.Z s.commit < uint.Z m.index → ¬PlogMatches s.base s.log { term' := m.logterm,
    index' := m.index } → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs
    (have __src := padoptLeader s m.src; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead :=
    __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, base := { term' :=
    m.logterm, index' := m.index }, log := [], commit := m.index, matched := __src.matched, rd :=
    __src.rd }) [Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id m.src s.term false m.index (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []])
    md

theorem rdOwn_arrive [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl : Option
    w64) (q : ReadReq) (e : EntryM) (c : List w8) (d : Option (w64 × GSet w64)) : s.role =
    Role.leader → q.index = s.commit → q.ents = [e] → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ rdOwn γ id s -∗
    ⌜e.Data' = c⌝ -∗ rqRecOk γ s.term ((c, s.commit), d) -∗ rdCred γ 1 ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗
    ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗ rdOwn γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role :=
    s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit,
    matched := s.matched, rd :=
                            have __src := s.rd;
                            { states := __src.states, ro := readonlyArrive s.rd.ro id q, pend := __src.pend } }

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_heartbeat [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) : m.ty = MsgType.heartbeat → m.dst = id → m.term = s.term → m.src ≠ id →
    s.role ≠ Role.leader → uint.Z m.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log → ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (have __src := padoptLeader s m.src; {
    term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes :=
    __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, base := __src.base, log := __src.log, commit :=
    plogCommitTo s.commit m.commit, matched := __src.matched, rd := __src.rd }) [have __src :=
    Msg.plain MsgType.heartbeatResp id m.src s.term false; { ty := __src.ty, src := __src.src, dst
    := __src.dst, term := __src.term, reject := __src.reject, index := __src.index, logterm :=
    __src.logterm, commit := __src.commit, rejecthint := __src.rejecthint, entries := __src.entries,
    cl := __src.cl, al := __src.al, ctx := m.ctx }]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_propose [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (ents : List EntryM) (n : Nat) : s.role = Role.leader → plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log
    + ↑ents.length < 2 ^ 64 → plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log + ↑ents.length ≤ ↑n + ↑γ.reBoot.length → ⊢
    ⧖n -∗ ([∗list] e ∈ ents, propData γ e) -∗ ([∗list] e ∈ ents, entTk γ e) -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s
    md ==∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs (pappend s (List.mapIdx (stamp s.term (plastIndex s)) ents))
    [pselfAck id (pappend s (List.mapIdx (stamp s.term (plastIndex s)) ents))]) md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_pend [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (m : Msg) (pm : MessageM) : m.ty = MsgType.readIndex → s.role = Role.leader → ⊢
    isMessage γ m -∗ rdCred γ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id {
    term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox :=
    s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                    have __src := s.rd;
                    { states := __src.states, ro := __src.ro, pend := s.rd.pend ++ [(pm, m.entries)] } }
                md

theorem ownLogGhost_hbAck [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (q : Nat) (recs : List RqRec) (hq : q ≤ recs.length) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ v s kl -∗
    ([∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ s.term r) -∗ ⌜HbAckOk v q recs⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_term1 [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → ∀ (t0 : w64), plogTermAt s.base s.log
    (W64 1) = some t0 → uint.Z t0 ≤ 1⌝ ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl

theorem lpfull_fp [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ldr t : w64) (bL : entryID) (l fp :
    List EntryM) : ⊢ lpfull γ ldr t bL l fp -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp ∗ ⌜FullOk bL fp ∧ PlogWf bL l ∧ ∀
    (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 (fp ++ l) j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z t⌝

theorem rcpt_frame [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {P : IProp GF} {k : Nat} (h : ⊢ P) : ⊢ ⧖k -∗ P

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_read_release [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id :
    w64) (s : PState) : s.role = Role.leader → plogTermAt s.base s.log s.commit = some s.term → ⊢
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id { term := s.term, vote :=
    s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base,
    log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd :=
                have __src := s.rd;
                { states := __src.states, ro := readonlyRelease s.rd.ro id s.commit s.rd.pend } }
            md

theorem ownRaftGhost_step_zeroAck [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {md : Bool} (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64)
    (s : PState) (dst : w64) : ⊢ ([∗list] m ∈ [], isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount []) -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id s md ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (psendMsgs s [Msg.mk
    MsgType.appResp id dst s.term false (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []]) md

theorem ownLogGhost_not_doomed_list [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (s : PState)
    (kl : Option w64) (recs : List RqRec) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ v s kl -∗ ([∗list] r ∈ recs, rqRecOk γ
    s.term r) -∗ ⌜∀ (r : RqRec), r ∈ recs → ∀ (t' : w64) (q : GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', q) → ¬v ∈
    q⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_not_doomed [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v : w64) (s : PState) (kl
    : Option w64) (r : RqRec) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ v s kl -∗ rqRecOk γ s.term r -∗ ⌜∀ (t' : w64) (q :
    GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', q) → ¬v ∈ q⌝

theorem lastRec_receipt [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (L : Int) : ⊢ lastRec γ L ==∗
    ⧖(L.toNat - γ.reBoot.length)

theorem rdOwn_ack [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (src q N : w64)
    (recs0 : List RqRec) (P : List EntryM) (c : CfgM) (X : IProp GF) (Hconf : ∀ (Q : GSet w64) (r :
    RqRec), JQuorum c Q → (∀ (v : w64), v ∈ Q → ∀ (t' : w64) (qq : GSet w64), r.snd = some (t', qq)
    → ¬v ∈ qq) → ⊢ X -∗ rqRecOk γ s.term r -∗ readOk γ r.fst.fst r.fst.snd) : s.role = Role.leader →
    CfgAt γ P c → JQuorumAcked c (fun v => ((readonlyRecvAck s.rd.ro src (u64Le q)).acks !! v).getD
    (W64 0)) N → HbAckOk src (uint.nat q) recs0 → ⊢ X -∗ rdOwn γ id s -∗ rqLb γ id s.term recs0 -∗ X
    ∗ rdOwn γ id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes,
    outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd
    :=
                            have __src := s.rd;
                            { states := __src.states,
                              ro := (readonlyAdvance (readonlyRecvAck s.rd.ro src (u64Le q)) N).fst,
                              pend := __src.pend } } ∗
                      [∗list] q' ∈ (readonlyAdvance (readonlyRecvAck s.rd.ro src (u64Le q)) N).snd, respFacts γ q'

theorem HbAckOk_prefix (v : w64) (k : Nat) (recs0 recs : List RqRec) : recs0 <+: recs → HbAckOk v k
    recs0 → HbAckOk v k recs
